title: Security architecture
description: Identities, assets, trust boundaries, flows and security controls.

credential.description: The kind of credential used, never its secret value.

detail.description: Specific credential type when type is other.

format.description: Representation such as JWT or X.509.

controlMechanism.description: An implementation mechanism used by a security control.

detail.description: Specific mechanism when type is other.

roleBinding.description: A role assignment and the actions it permits in the depicted scope.

authorizationAttribute.description: An attribute or context input to an authorization decision.

categoryDetail.description: Specific category when category is other.

sourceIds.description: Elements providing or authoritatively assigning the attribute.

delegation.description: One described on-behalf-of delegation; record identities and constraints, never credential values.

subjectId.description: Principal on whose behalf the actor operates.

grantorId.description: Principal that grants this delegation, when known.

issuerId.description: Element that issues the delegated credential, when known.

expiresIn.description: Described validity period, such as 5 minutes.

revocation.description: How revocation or invalidation is handled, when known.

controlImplementation.description: How a control is implemented and enforced, using IDs from the architecture.

implementedBy.description: Elements containing the implementation or configuration.

enforcedBy.description: Elements that enforce the control on the relevant requests or flows.

identityProvider.description: Identity provider responsible for authentication, when applicable.

identityProviders.description: Identity providers authenticating represented principals; use instead of identityProvider. Credential issuer and trust checks are described separately.

decisionPoint.description: Element that evaluates the authorization policy, when distinct from enforcement.

decisionPoints.description: Multiple elements that evaluate the policy; use instead of decisionPoint.

decisionTopology.description: Where decisions are evaluated, independently of policy administration.

decisionTopologyDetail.description: Specific topology when decisionTopology is other.

policyAdministration.description: How policy authority is organized, independently of decision placement.

policyAdministrationDetail.description: Specific administration model when policyAdministration is other.

policyAuthorityIds.description: Elements authorized to define or administer relevant policy.

roleBindings.description: Role assignments and permissions relevant to this control.

attributes.description: Subject, resource, action and environment inputs relevant to a decision.

delegations.description: Explicitly described delegated access grants or hops.

principalIds.description: Actors or workloads subject to the control.

resourceIds.description: Elements or resources protected by the control.

credentials.description: Credential types accepted or checked by the control.

claims.description: Claim names used in authentication or authorization.

actions.description: Operations governed by the authorization policy.

policy.description: Plain-language decision rule and relevant conditions.

kind.description: Role of the element in the security view.

controlTypeDetail.description: Specific function when controlType is other.

controlIds.description: IDs of controls applying to this element.

dataClassification.description: Classification of the data carried by the relationship.

classificationDetail.description: Specific classification when dataClassification is other.

controlIds.description: IDs of controls applying to this relationship or flow.
